ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: shadowmancer
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Shadowmancers deal in what can't be seen: curses, stealth and the dread that turns brave raiders into fleeing children.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Hexes, stealth and terror. Strike from the dark and leave nothing but fear.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: Most colonies have a story about the thing in the dark. Some colonies have a shadowmancer instead.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: A cunning debuffer and burst damage dealer. Curse priority targets with Hex of Doom, terrify crowds, slip away with Cloak of Shadows. Wants Celerity and Potency.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: assassin
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Assassins end fights before they start. They blink behind the most dangerous enemy, kill it, and are gone before anyone reacts.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Appear, kill, vanish. Executions, poisons and the Death Lotus.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: The raid leader was the first to die. Nobody saw who did it.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Single-target burst and executions. Mark for Death, Backstab, vanish in Smoke Bomb, repeat. Wants Celerity and Attunement.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: hexer
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Hexers collect curses the way others collect coins. Agony, silence, bad luck, and - when they're feeling playful - polymorph.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Curses for every occasion. Agony, silence, and turning raiders into chickens.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: Old Margit's chickens all have names. Some of them used to be pirates.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: Stack curses on dangerous enemies and neutralize the rest. Polymorph removes a threat entirely. Malediction cripples whole raids. Wants Attunement and Focus.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.label: hemomancer
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.description: Hemomancers spend blood like mana: their own, their allies' and especially their enemies'.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.tagline: Blood is power. Cast with your own life, take theirs in return.
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.lore: 'Don't worry,' she said, slicing her palm. 'It's not my blood for long.'
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneClassDef.playstyle: High-risk, high-reward. Your spells can cost health, and your lifesteal pays it back. Blood Pact lets you keep casting with an empty mana pool. Wants Potency and Resilience.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: dread
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Night Terror spreads to everyone near the target, and you know exactly how fear breaks people.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: living nightmare
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Enemies near you are steadily cursed and weakened.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: silhouette
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Strike from where they least expect. Huge spell critical chance and damage.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: shadow lord
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: When struck, you may melt into the shadows for free.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: bladedancer
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Each kill resets your rhythm: cooldowns shrink and mana returns.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: executioner
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Shadow spells execute anything below a quarter of its health.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: shadowdance
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Kills flow into the next: shadow kills often trigger a free Backstab on the nearest enemy.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: dark covenant
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your curses last a quarter longer.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: lord of curses
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Every curse spills over: curse spells affect enemies around the target too.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: barnyard
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Polymorph strikes extra targets, and curses sometimes polymorph for free. The farm grows.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: blood pact
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: When you run out of mana, your spells are paid for with your own blood instead.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: hemophage
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: The more you bleed, the stronger your blood magic.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: sanguinarch
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: The blood of your enemies flows to you: massive lifesteal and blood damage.

ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.label: the undying blood
ArcanumAscendant.ArcaneNodeDef.description: Your blood refuses to stop. When downed, you rise again fully healed. Once per day.

AbilityDef.label: shadow bolt
AbilityDef.description: A bolt of living darkness.

AbilityDef.label: shadowstep
AbilityDef.description: Step into one shadow and out of another, moving faster and harder to hit for a while.

AbilityDef.label: hex of doom
AbilityDef.description: Curse a target to suffer more from every wound. Recasting deepens the curse.

AbilityDef.label: cloak of shadows
AbilityDef.description: Wrap yourself in shadow and vanish from enemy sight for fifteen seconds.

AbilityDef.label: night terror
AbilityDef.description: Fill a mind with nightmares. The target flees in terror, weakened.

AbilityDef.label: shadow sight
AbilityDef.description: Send your shadow out across the land. Everything hidden within a huge radius is revealed.

AbilityDef.label: leech
AbilityDef.description: Siphon life from a target through a tendril of shadow.

AbilityDef.label: umbral eruption
AbilityDef.description: Darkness bursts from the ground around you, tearing and blinding everyone nearby.

AbilityDef.label: eclipse
AbilityDef.description: Swallow the sun. Darkness falls across the map for six hours, and every enemy near you is blinded by the sudden night.

AbilityDef.label: shadow bind
AbilityDef.description: Shadows lash out from the ground and drag every enemy in the area toward the center, holding them in place.

AbilityDef.label: backstab
AbilityDef.description: Blink behind the target and drive a shadow blade into it. Executes the badly wounded.

AbilityDef.label: toxic fan
AbilityDef.description: Throw a fan of poisoned daggers.

AbilityDef.label: smoke bomb
AbilityDef.description: Shatter a vial of shadow smoke: enemies inside are blinded and you vanish.

AbilityDef.label: mark for death
AbilityDef.description: Mark a single enemy. Everything hurts it more, and it cannot hide.

AbilityDef.label: death lotus
AbilityDef.description: Become a whirlwind of shadow blades, flickering between up to nine enemies. Each strike executes the weakened.

AbilityDef.label: shadow dance
AbilityDef.description: Flicker from enemy to enemy, appearing behind each one for a single killing cut.

AbilityDef.label: curse of agony
AbilityDef.description: A curse of creeping agony that grows worse with each casting.

AbilityDef.label: hex of silence
AbilityDef.description: Silence and stun the minds of everyone in an area.

AbilityDef.label: polymorph
AbilityDef.description: Turn an enemy into a chicken for half a minute. If the chicken dies, so does the enemy.

AbilityDef.label: hex swarm
AbilityDef.description: A swarm of hexes that each curse a different nearby enemy with something random and unpleasant.

AbilityDef.label: malediction
AbilityDef.description: The great curse. Every enemy in a vast area is doomed, withered, weakened, silenced and wracked with agony.

AbilityDef.label: stone gaze
AbilityDef.description: Meet their eyes with the gaze of the gorgon. They turn to stone for ten seconds: helpless, but hard to hurt.

AbilityDef.label: blood lance
AbilityDef.description: Form a spear of your own blood and hurl it. Costs health.

AbilityDef.label: hemorrhage
AbilityDef.description: Every enemy in an area begins to bleed uncontrollably.

AbilityDef.label: blood frenzy
AbilityDef.description: Boil your blood: faster attacks, harder hits and lifesteal.

AbilityDef.label: transfusion
AbilityDef.description: Give your own blood to save an ally: a huge heal for them, a wound for you.

AbilityDef.label: crimson tide
AbilityDef.description: Your blood erupts outward in a red wave: crushing damage to every enemy around you, and you drink half of it back.

AbilityDef.label: blood harvest
AbilityDef.description: Pull the blood out of every enemy in an area through their skin. You drink a third of what you take.

HediffDef.label: agony
HediffDef.description: A curse of creeping, ever-worsening pain. Stacks.

HediffDef.label: petrified
HediffDef.description: Turned to stone. Cannot move, but stone is hard to break.
